title: E-FRC-0068: the electroweak-Planck hierarchy and the inflation amplitude scale, re-expressed as logarithms base...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0068 in the gauge arena: the electroweak-Planck hierarchy and the inflation amplitude scale, re-expressed as logarithms base lambda, are modest shell counts (about 13 and 4), a Randall-Sundrum style reformulation that reduces the fine-tuning question to a shell-count question, not a generation of the hierarchy, and the pass gates accept any lambda from about 8 to 2183 so lambda itself does no work here.
known_limitations: Depth L1 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed).
